construction: Original on-time paper R8 Supper body allocation, evaluated with current native B abilities and explicit normal recruit Larder items. This plants a settled state; it does not claim a native B shop history reproduces the paper's earlier turns.
assumptions: The deterministic original paper run was checked directly: R8 active 105, gold 0, Larder 17, no tribe bonus. R7 holds 16; R9 feeds 18 after the next Sorrel Acorn arrives.
The six normal bodies and positions reproduce the original on-time R8 paper snapshot. F4 stays empty so B3 Dozey receives Pass and Urchin's Hunker.
Partner stayed in B1 from R1: eight settled End of Turns. Dozey stayed in B3 from R7: two settled End of Turns, first wake due at R9. These clocks are planted explicitly.

Current native B parameters remain authoritative. In particular Partner pays two Acorns per touching Hedgerow, Beadle Passes +2/+2, Mallow doubles two targets and Dozey food gives +2/+2 per gold. They exceed the original paper dials; no claim is made that their previous native turns produce this 105-stat allocation.

Larder items are given through normal RecruitRules before planting the settled bodies, avoiding replaying historical Beadle gains onto already-costed stats. Normal combination values make 17 gold one Great Hoard plus one Acorn; 16 is one Great Hoard.

The 16-fuel recipe is a one-gold sensitivity beside the exact 17-fuel paper state. No goldens, hero, Rings, Belly reserves, borrowed text, recruiting continuation or invented combat mechanics are supplied. Fixed R8 fights do not spend or double the held fuel.
